cohort: 149,671 singleton pregnancies with information about ECV success or failure
finding: Nulliparity, female sex, low fetal weight centile, high pre-pregnancy BMI, high BMI at delivery, and high maternal weight gain during pregnancy were associated with an increased ECV failure, while African American, American Indian and Alaska Native race categories, and younger maternal age (< 25 years) and old maternal age (> 40 years) were significant protective factors against ECV failure.
mod_finding: Among the failed ECV procedures, 63.11% of pregnancies were delivered by cesarean section.
